remediationSteps.summary: Delete the test cache and retry the test.

Remove the cached .cache-lock/<spec-file>.cache.js entry so page.ai regenerates selectors, locators, and assertions against the live DOM,
then rerun the automation to confirm recovery before escalating.

remediationSteps.summary: Review the page.ai instruction if the fresh run still fails.
remediationSteps.details: If cache regeneration and an autonomous retry still fail, the objective may no longer be achievable on the current page; revisit the page.ai instruction or the test expectations.

additionalDataRequests.description: Compare the cached instructions against the current page structure.

heuristics.notes: The failure originates in Donobu-generated cached instructions, not user test code. Cache regeneration and an autonomous retry are recommended. Historical data shows a prior run recovered on retry. Automated retry has high likelihood of success.
